comment: Operator-ratified exemptions for known-dark declarations (DR-190). Every pin prints as PINNED-DARK on every gate run; a pin whose subject comes alive is a STALE PIN and FAILS the gate. Pins exceeding KILL_RATIO (0.1) of checked surfaces DISARM the floor by design. Treat this file as an attack surface: a stale pin hiding a live path is a governance lie.
